basic.title: Basic Information
basic.description: Manage your administrator name and avatar.
basic.name: Name
basic.avatarHelp: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 2 MB. A square image works best.

password.title: Change Password
password.description: Update your password regularly to protect your administrator account.
password.newPlaceholder: At least 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and numbers
password.confirmRequired: Please enter the new password again
password.updated: Password updated and sessions on other devices revoked

security.title: Account Security
security.description: Review your current sign-in and manage sessions on other devices.
security.passwordNote: Changing your password requires the current password and revokes every token except the current session.
security.mfaNote: MFA is not included in the base package yet. Key encryption, recovery codes, and enforcement policies require a separate design.

systemName.description: The system name displayed in the upper-left corner of the administration panel.
systemName.label: System name

pageSize.description: Set the default number of records displayed per page, from 10 to 100.
pageSize.label: Default page size
